mechanism: A simple diary can help observe sleep patterns without diagnosing insomnia
instructions: Record approximate sleep and wake times optionally.
Review patterns without scoring medical outcomes.
expected_outcomes: Potential improvements in user-reported coping, choice, engagement or comfort; not demonstrated for this specific exercise

evidence.limitations: full CBT-I is a clinician-guided multi-component treatment; sleep hygiene alone insufficient
